chunks: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Ali al-Sukkari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya informed us. He said: Ahmad b. Isa narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad b. Abdullah b. al-Hasan from Zayd b. Ali, peace be upon him. He said:
Whoever comes to the grave of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, recognizing his right, Allah will forgive his past and future sins.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn according to Zayd b. Ali?
ai.summary: Zayd b. Ali (as) declares that whoever visits the grave of Imam al-Husayn (as) with true recognition of his rightful status will receive complete forgiveness from Allah for all past and future sins. This hadith was delivered in the context of Safar 18, 368 AH — a date closely associated with the mourning of Imam al-Husayn — and would have been understood by its original audience as a powerful encouragement for the ziyara (pilgrimage) tradition central to Shia devotion.
